visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a purple polo shirt, is shown from the chest up in a bright indoor gallery. He holds a jagged white mineral specimen in his left hand and a black UV flashlight in his right, shining the beam onto the rock to reveal glowing pink and purple fluorescent spots. He examines the specimen with a focused, professional expression. The background features glass display cases filled with various minerals and fossils under bright, cool-toned lighting. (2) As the camera zooms in slightly on his face, the man's expression shifts from focused concentration to a look of confusion and disbelief. He blinks and looks slightly off-camera as if processing a strange comment. Large yellow and white text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame, providing context and captions. (3) The man stares directly into the lens with a 'deadpan' expression, appearing completely speechless and stunned. He remains mostly still, occasionally blinking, while the mineral in his hand continues to glow under the UV light. The background displays remain visible but slightly out of focus due to the closer shot.
